Hi, thanks for the note. So, you would like two extra reports a month. Let me be straight with you: those are not in the current scope, but I am not going to say no. Here is what I would suggest. If we move you to a monthly retainer instead of the fixed contract, the two reports come inside it and you stop worrying about what is included. And one condition on our side: if your team sends the data by the tenth, the reports will be ready in the same month rather than the following one. If that works for you, I will follow up with a revised proposal today.

Let me ask you something. How many people do you have on this internally? Three, is that right? Two on payroll and one part-time on tax. Now, if we took the whole thing over, you would not need three. You would keep one person as our point of contact, and you would move the other two into the finance team you told me you have been trying to build for a year. That is the part people miss. It is not about cutting heads, it is about where those heads sit. I am not going to give you a number today. Go and work out what those three people cost you, all in, and then we will have a much more useful conversation.
